verdict.rationale: BugSnag publishes a Data Access API with an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec for pulling error and project data, and a community user scripted exception dumps against it. An official SmartBear MCP server exists with OAuth support, and a built-in Jira/issue-tracker integration can create and sync issues, so the pull-triage-file loop is covered by first-party pieces. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the API or MCP tools return full stack traces and rank top issues, evidence that an agent can file tracker issues programmatically rather than through the dashboard integration, and hands-on corroboration of the MCP workflow.
